help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Enwere m ike idebe foto nke onwe?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: Iji soro mgbanwe ụfọdụ a na-ahụ anya.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Ee. Foto nzuzo echekwara nke ọma dị, dịka ọmụmaatụ iji soro otú pimples, uto ntutu ma ọ bụ mgbaàmà akpụkpọ ahụ si agbanwe.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: Kedu ka AWA si echekwa data m?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Nzuzo, nchekwa na ikpokọta data nta.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: E wuru AWA n'ikpokọta data nta, enweghị mgbasa ozi a na-atụle onye, enweghị ire data nke onwe, yana nchekwa dị mma nwere ezi encryption nke data dị mkpa.
help.faq.security-export.question: Enwere m ike iweputa data m?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: A na-akwado mbupụ PDF na CSV.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Ee. Mbupụ PDF nke nsochi gị na mbupụ CSV nke data gị dị, ka ị nwee ike ịmepụta akụkọ doro anya, gụnyere maka ọkachamara ahụike.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Enwere m ike ihichapụ data m n'ụzọ dị mfe?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Ihichapụ na-anọgide dị mfe ma dị ire.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Ee. Ihichapụ dị mfe nke data gị na akaụntụ gị dị site na ntọala kwesịrị ekwesị.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Ịmalite na AWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Chọpụta ihuenyo ụlọ gị, kalenda, akwụkwọ ndekọ, nzube na akara ime mmụọ.
help.guides.cycle.title: Nsochi okirikiri ọnwa
help.guides.cycle.text: Dekọọ ịhụ ọnwa gị, oke ọbara, ma lelee nlere anya okirikiri ọnwa gị.
help.guides.conceive.title: Ịnwa ịtụrụ ime
help.guides.conceive.text: Soro ịtụrụ ime, ovulation, okpomọkụ ahụ n'ụra, mucus cervical na nyocha LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Contraception
help.guides.contraception.text: Jikwaa ụzọ gị, ncheta, doses ị gafere na akụkọ ịṅụ ọgwụ.
help.guides.irregular.title: Okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Lelee okirikiri ọnwa na-ezighị ezi, pimples, uto ntutu, ịdị arọ na mgbaàmà metụtara ya.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Soro hot flashes, ụra, ike ọgwụgwụ, ọnọdụ obi na ọgwụgwọ hormone.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Nsochi ime
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Soro ụbọchị ịmụ nwa gị, izu, oge nzute, nyocha na mgbaàmà.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Mgbe a mụsịrị nwa
help.guides.postpartum.text: Soro lochia, ịlọghachi nke okirikiri ọnwa, ịra nwa ara, ụra, ọnọdụ obi na ahụ ike.
help.guides.loss.title: Mgbe ime wee dọpụ
help.guides.loss.text: Soro ọbara, mgbaàmà, na ịlọghachi nke okirikiri ọnwa gị n'ọsọ gị.
help.guides.calendar.title: Ịgba kalenda
help.guides.calendar.text: Ghọta ịhụ ọnwa, nlere anya, akara, na ngosi Gregorian / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Imejupụta akwụkwọ ndekọ kwa ụbọchị gị
help.guides.journal.text: Dekọọ mgbaàmà, ọnọdụ obi, ụra, mmega ahụ, ihe edeturu na nzuzo.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Iji akara ime mmụọ
help.guides.spiritual.text: Chọpụta kalenda Hijri, ịdị ọcha, ekpere, ibu ọnụ, qadaa na nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Nzuzo na data
help.guides.privacy.text: Jikwaa nchekwa, ụdị nzuzo, mbupụ, encryption na ihichapụ data.

help.helpSupport.guidesSubtitle: Chọpụta ntuziaka anyị ka ị nweta ọtụtụ uru site na AWA.
help.helpSupport.feedbackSubtitle: Kekọrịta echiche gị ka ị nyere anyị aka imelite app.

help.helpSupport.bannerText: Daalụ maka ịdị njikere ide anyị.
